purpose: Estimate a daily A-share stock-level executable conditional distribution on the corrected Seq100 input before any portfolio or profitability decision.

epistemic_contract.prior_project_results_are: historical observations and falsifiable hypotheses only

target.planned_exit: adjusted close at H trading days after signal
target.t_plus_one: no liquidation is modeled before D2 after next-open entry

factor_construction.market_component: leave-one-out equal-weight mean shadow log return within signal date
factor_construction.industry_component: leave-one-out PIT industry mean minus leave-one-out market mean within signal date
factor_construction.residual: executable log return minus the two components
factor_construction.small_or_unknown_industry: fall back to leave-one-out market component

target.right_censoring: A_sell_H=0 and tau_sell_H=retry_days+1 when no legal sellable close exists in the bounded retry window

core.role: scale-stable market, industry, price-path, cross-sectional, size, liquidity, and status coordinates

core_minute.role: same-day realized volatility, semivariance, tail-bar, closing-path, and amount-concentration proxies

initial_learning_rules.scale: date-equal weighted ridge regression on log squared location residual
initial_learning_rules.tail: Student-t likelihood calibrated on training residuals only
initial_learning_rules.sample_cap: deterministic maximum 64 training stocks per signal date for the first bounded baseline

evaluation.semantics: 2023-2025 are burned retrospective folds, not untouched confirmation data
evaluation.purge: H + 20 trading days, because the executable label includes the bounded retry window
evaluation.date_weighting: each signal date has total weight one

decision_boundary.future_utility: expected log wealth minus CVaR under state-dependent costs, turnover, capacity, and cash constraints
decision_boundary.minimum_final_gate: selection-adjusted 95 percent lower confidence bound of net utility improvement is positive on an unused confirmation period
